SCHEDULED POWER INTERRUPTION: SEPTEMBER 15, 2026
Ginapahibalo sang Negros Power ang mga konsumidores nga may ara sang natalana nga power interruption sa September 15, 2026 (Tuesday).
Ini kabahin sang 5-year rehabilitation kag modernization plan sang Negros Power agud malikawan ang mga wala ginalauman kag mas lapnagon nga power interruptions kag mangin reliable ang distribution system sang aton elektrisidad.
Yari ang mga detalye sang scheduled power interruption:
Date: September 15, 2026 (Tuesday)
Reason: 
● Replacement of wooden secondary pole into 40ft. Steel pole;
● Erection of two 40ft. steel pole secondary line rehabilitation; and
● Massive vegetation clearing.
Time & Affected Areas:
9:00AM to 5:00PM
Portion of LF3 - Portion of Sitio Mambag-id and Sitio Roma, Brgy. Balaring, Silay City. 
Madamo gid nga salamat sa inyo nga pag hangop.
#NegrosPowerRehab
#PadayonAngRehabilitasyon
#ForBetterElectricService
